meta.strategy: The PAS strategy here addresses the systemic exclusion of underserved communities from high-fashion. We frame the 'Problem' as a barrier to dignity, the 'Agitation' as the cultural erasure of low-income identities, and 'Nectar' as the 'Solution' that bridges this gap with accessible, high-end aesthetics.
meta.tone: Empowering, sophisticated, inclusive, and socially conscious.

content.headline: EXCLUSION IS OUT OF FASHION

steps.title: The Elitist Barrier
steps.description: Luxury fashion has long been used as a tool for exclusion, designed to make underserved communities feel invisible through impossible price tags and gated narratives.

steps.title: Dignity Deferred
steps.description: When you are priced out of high-quality design, you are priced out of the global cultural conversation. This exclusion isn't just financial—it's a denial of your right to self-expression and social dignity.

steps.title: The Nectar Bridge
steps.description: We dismantle the barriers. Nectar delivers refined, designer-level streetwear directly to the street, ensuring luxury aesthetics are an inclusive birthright for the underserved.

content.closing_statement: Dignity is the new luxury. Join the movement that refuses to leave anyone behind.
